Weng.Modeler
Class DbPoint

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.Modeler.DbEntity
        |
        +--Weng.Modeler.DbPoint
public class DbPoint
extends DbEntity

Use this class to create, query and manipulate a point entity that resides in the modeler's database.

If you want to get ordinate data from a point entity, make call such as myPoint.Point().X()
